keyPoints: POST /ideas enforces project linkage by resolving project_id server-side via project name, rejecting unregistered projects

PATCH /ideas/{id} and PATCH /ideas/{id}/bot are two distinct routes with different privilege scopes: the former accepts either auth mode but only ever writes with machine_write=False (bot fields stay locked even with a valid machine key on this route); the latter is machine-key-only and is the sole path that writes with machine_write=True
POST /ideas/{id}/run-bot's optional model field is validated against an allowlist (gpt-4o, gpt-5-mini, gpt-4.1) before being injected as an env var into the job execution
POST /projects now supports machine key authentication alongside user authentication, enabling automated project creation
Backward compatibility: existing entities with old 'repos' JSON list have their first entry promoted to the 'repo' field on read
New 'bot_blocked_by' field added to support tracking cross-repo dependencies, integrated into the bot-managed fields alongside 'bot_status', 'bot_pr_url', and 'bot_error'
architecture.overview: HTTP-triggered Azure Functions backed by Table Storage. EasyAuth handles browser auth transparently at the Azure layer — no auth code in the application. A separate machine key enables automation (ideas-bot, external scripts) to write ideas and create projects without user credentials. Idea creation resolves project_id server-side by project name, ensuring all ideas are linked to registered projects.

dataFlow.label: Create idea with project linkage
sublines: Resolves project_id server-side via project name
Rejects idea creation if no matching project is registered

description: Azure Functions app that stores and serves feature ideas in Table Storage. Supports two auth modes: browser JWT tokens via EasyAuth for read access, and an X-Ideas-Key machine write-key for automated writes. Exposes a trigger endpoint for the ideas-bot.
features: PATCH /api/ideas/{id} — updates ordinary idea fields (EasyAuth JWT or X-Ideas-Key); does NOT unlock bot-managed fields
PATCH /api/ideas/{id}/bot — a separate, machine-key-ONLY route that writes bot_status, bot_pr_url, bot_error, and bot_blocked_by
POST /api/ideas/{id}/run-bot — accepts an optional model override (gpt-4o, gpt-5-mini, or gpt-4.1) that's passed through to the triggered Container App Job as AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT
POST /api/ideas — enforces project linkage by resolving project_id server-side via project name, rejecting unregistered projects
POST /api/projects — now supports both EasyAuth JWT authentication and X-Ideas-Key machine write-key for project creation
role: Stores/serves AI-generated feature ideas; triggers ideas-bot
summary: Stores and serves AI-generated feature ideas and project data in Azure Table Storage. Enforces project linkage on idea creation, keyed by project name, and rejects unregistered projects. Accepts browser JWT tokens via EasyAuth for read access and an X-Ideas-Key machine write-key for automated writes, now extended to project creation.
